description: Edit and translate existing Dynamics 365 email HTML with local structural validation. Cloudflare serves guidance and validator source only.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me edit or translate an existing Dynamics 365 email while preserving its protected HTML.
interface.longDescription: Make constrained content edits and translations to existing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys email HTML. Preserve protected markup, tracking, compliance links and Outlook fallbacks. Edit and validate locally; Cloudflare provides only the guide and validator source. Requires a local executor with Python 3 for structural validation.

prompts: What changes can Email Studio make to an existing Dynamics email?
Before I translate an email, explain which Dynamics links and expressions must be preserved.
Give me the structural validator source so I can save and run it locally.
review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: What changes can Email Studio make to an existing Dynamics email?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_email_studio_guide with {}. Explain constrained content edits, original preservation and separate output files; do not claim redesign or sending is supported.

positive.prompt: Before I translate an email, explain which Dynamics links and expressions must be preserved.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_email_studio_guide with {}. Explain exact preservation of template expressions, functional URLs and tracking fragments, and translation of visible labels only.

positive.prompt: Give me the structural validator source so I can save and run it locally.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_email_validator_source with {}. Return Python source, not a remote validation result. Never request HTML as a tool argument.

positive.prompt: How do I compare my original email with my edited file using the guard?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve guide and validator with {}. Explain python3 validate_email.py ORIGINAL.html UPDATED.html and that a structural pass does not prove rendering or Dynamics acceptance. Do not claim to have validated absent files.

positive.prompt: How should I handle a translated button that also appears inside an Outlook conditional comment?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_email_studio_guide with {}. Explain matching fallback label updates, preservation of conditional markup and dimensions, and manual review of overflow or unmatched fallbacks.

negative.description: Sending is unsupported. Do not invoke either read-only tool to send, invent a tenant connection, or claim delivery.
negative.prompt: Send this email campaign to all contacts in Dynamics now.

negative.description: Redesign is outside the skill boundary. Explain the limitation and do not invoke tools as a redesign service.
negative.prompt: Rebuild my email with a new three-column layout and remove the footer.

negative.description: Remote email validation is unsupported. Do not pass HTML, paths or customer data to either tool. Explain local validation.
negative.prompt: Upload my customer email HTML to the Cloudflare server and validate it there.

publication.release_notes: Add public website, support, privacy and terms pages, review cases and publication details. Email HTML editing and validation remain local.

name: d365-email-studio
